positions.title: Quality Assurance Engineer II
positions.description:
Automation Development
• Write and maintain coded user interface automated tests for web application using C# in Visual Studio
• Setup automated test code framework
• Write and maintain SQL scripts
• Setup test controllers and test agents to create a lab testing environment using Microsoft Test Manager
• Train and mentor test team members on automation development
• Assist in writing integration tests
• Developed custom build template workflow

Web Application Testing
• Run system verification tests against builds
• Run automated tests using MTM or Visual Studio
• Inspect solution for gaps in integration test coverage
• Assist is code debugging
• Develop and maintain manual test cases
• Complete exploratory and user experience testing against application
• Complete quality assurance using Agile methodologies

positions.title: System Test Engineering Contractor
positions.description:
Long Term Evolution (LTE) Test Case Development
• Developed emergency over IP multimedia subsystem (IMS) stack testing scripts using Rapid Test Designer (RTD) and ProLab setups
• Developed LTE idle-mode signaling reduction (ISR) scripts to verify non-access stratum (NAS) performance
• Tested LTE inter-radio access technology (IRAT) scenarios using RTD software coupled with Anritsu mobile system simulators and Anite systems
• Studied and followed LTE, UMTS, GSM, and GPRS 3GPP wireless standards for mobile system behavior
• Reviewed UE logs to assist in modem debugging
• Revised stack scripts to follow new 3GPP release standards
• Ran and maintained protocol stack tests using RTD and Anite systems
• Assisted and trained interns to run mobile stack tests

Automation Development
• Wrote and maintained extensible markup language (XML) scripts to communicate between RTD or Anite server and client PCs to run mobile device stack testing

projects.title: MAC Protocol Design
projects.description: The goal of this project was to design a MAC layer protocol for a wireless network. The restriction of the project was that the protocol layer must work with the existing 802.11n physical layer characteristics. It was a high speed network design that supported both asynchronous and isochronous data traffic where all communication was coordinated through a network coordinator using requests and grants. It minimized 802.11n collisions, packet error rate and major 802.11n overheads like SIFS, DIFS, RTS, CTS and ACK.

projects.title: Situational Awareness Application
projects.description: The situational awareness application was a summer internship team project. The restriction of the project was that there would be no data connection available for the users of the application. Also, we had to minimize the power consumption used. We decided to use a Wi-Fi network since the effective range is larger than in a Bluetooth network. My focus of the project was then to develop the mapping portion of the application. I created the map using downloadable Google maps to show the GPS location and other statistics of the users. The application was completed within the time duration and was the most successful of the team projects.
